scenes.title: The Threshold
scenes.description: Canonical-classical-framed visual prompt: a traveler pauses at an unmarked threshold. This generic staging does not claim to depict a particular textual episode.

shots.foreground_action: A traveler pauses before a plain threshold and looks toward an unmarked inscription.
shots.secondary_action: A companion waits at a respectful distance without touching the inscription.
shots.crowd_action: A few distant figures pass quietly in the background.
shots.visual_description: Neutral, non-specific setting; no quoted text or identifiable sacred object.
shots.continuity_notes: Illustrative shot prompt only; it is not a generated take.

shots.foreground_action: The traveler steps back from the threshold and turns toward the open path.
shots.secondary_action: The companion gestures toward the path, leaving the choice with the traveler.
shots.crowd_action: Background passersby continue at an unhurried pace.
shots.visual_description: A quiet continuation of the generic threshold motif.
shots.continuity_notes: Illustrative shot prompt only; it is not a generated take.

shots.foreground_action: In the disclosed alternate, a traveler notices a small lantern beside an open doorway.
shots.secondary_action: A companion remains on the path and watches as the traveler considers the doorway.
shots.crowd_action: No crowd enters the doorway; distant figures remain on the public path.
shots.visual_description: Invented counterfactual elements; do not present as source-derived.
